summary: Regional Management Corp. filed an 8-K under items 2.02 (Results of Operations) and 8.01 (Other Events) to announce first-quarter 2026 financial results and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share. The filing covers earnings release and conference call details; no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is disclosed. The dividend declaration is routine. The registrant is acting as issuer in reporting ordinary financial and dividend information.
